title: page:header ignores the spec's variant "danger": a danger action (leave_organization, delete_organization) draws as a filled blue primary, with no red row and no separator in ⋯
body:
Filing gate: **(b) a named producer is blocked by it.** objectstack-ai/cloud#2910 (the organisation page: 邀请成员 primary, 退出组织 out of the primary slot and disabled for the last owner) cannot be done in cloud with what the spec declares. The os-dev on that card measured each gap with contract probes at framework `f7e836da` / objectui `ef71a09f` (report on cloud#2910). Filed by the `repo:cloud#1` seat (seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6026, session `session_01WVbr5J6u8BHh8EyFtcWciH`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Dedupe: no open objectui issue names `page:header` with the `danger` variant.

## What the user sees
On the cloud staging walk (cloud#2910 Evidence, `cloud-org-page-leave-primary.jpg`), 退出组织, the platform's `variant: 'danger'` `leave_organization`, is drawn as the filled blue primary of the organisation page.

## Where (objectui `ef71a09f`; same at `main` `8296c6c3`, L2078, L2258)
- `packages/components/src/renderers/layout/containers.tsx` reads destructive only as `variant === 'destructive'` or `name === 'sys_delete'`. This applies to the ⋯ band and separator (L2067–2068, L2117) and the red row (L2246–2247). Inline buttons draw only `default` or `outline` (L2166).
- The spec's word is `danger` (`packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts` L1306: "danger = destructive"). `destructive` is not a spec value.

## Done when
`page:header` reads `variant: 'danger'` as destructive:
- a red row below a separator in ⋯;
- a destructive inline style when it is shown inline;
- never the filled primary.

A test covers `danger`.
